verdict.rationale: The docs say Nix can fetch pre-built binaries from a binary cache, a web server, which is the substitute-source mechanism a private mirror would use. A community user describes sharing builds from in-house remote builders across devs, CI and deployment, which suggests private caching infrastructure is workable. Missing for 10: documentation on configuring custom or private cache/mirror URLs, any evidence of authentication (scoped or otherwise), and hands-on corroboration of private-registry setup.
